verdict.rationale: Kong Gateway's core documented functionality directly covers this story: advanced routing, load balancing, and health checking configurable via Admin API or declarative config (kong-gh-5, kong-gh-14, kong-gh-18), request/response transformation plugins (kong-gh-3), and reverse-proxy architecture (kong-docs-1). A GitHub issue reports an intermittent, hard-to-reproduce router cache bug (kong-comm-1), but this is an isolated edge case rather than evidence the core routing/load-balancing/transformation capability fails as claimed. Missing for 10: independent benchmark/production corroboration beyond vendor docs and GitHub descriptions, and resolution confirmation for the cited routing bug.
